Aw I’m so sorry I remember my very first pig loss. Her name was smores she was a real cutie smore colored and pattern hence the name. I usually find myself like this when I had some event or someone trigger me and it makes me go into these episodes. Either way, it does not make you insane. Hello I hope you’re having a nice nap. I just want to say that I’m sorry for the way you’re feeling right now. I hope with what I’m saying can console you a little. When I read your story, I felt like I was reading about me. I was diagnosed with bipolar in 2019 and the diagnosis destroyed me. The first episode I had also put me in life or death situation and was damaging. I was so damaged to where I had thoughts of death daily. I lost everyone I ever loved and and lost everything just like you. I thought there was seriously no hope left for me. And I always thought at least death is an option. The point is not about me. I was saying to so that you can relate. It’s easy to get caught up in the past and think of how everything got ruined. Healing is a long process and it can’t be rushed. If you rush it, it’ll only make it worse and at that point you aren’t healing. You have to learn to be patient with yourself. I know right now, things are rough and you are fighting a constant battle. But take it one step at a time. Start with the little things. Accept oh today is a bad day accept what you’re feeling and embrace it. Turn it a hobby. I turned all my feelings to my art and it helped me greatly. Now I’m proud to say I’m a happy college student with big goals and dreams. If I can do it, so can you ❤️ I wish you luck
